answer: Sybil resistance follows from reputation’s exponential temporal half-life: every vertex must provide sustained honest service across repeated epochs to preserve eigenvector centrality, while inactivity and recent creation rapidly reduce its score. Thus a freshly spawned sybil, whether labeled knoll or saffron, starts with near-zero eigenvector centrality, receives negligible reciprocal trust, and cannot accumulate sufficient transitive weight to pass consensus.
